{

  "arms": [

      "name": "Cemiplimab",

    {
      "name": "Pemetrexed",

    },
    {
      "name": "Topotecan",
      "type": "active comparator",
      "dose": "1 mg/m2",
      "route": "IV",

      "duration_weeks": 96
    },
    {
      "name": "Irinotecan",
      "type": "active comparator",
      "dose": "100 mg/m2",
      "route": "IV",

      "duration_weeks": 96
    },
    {
      "name": "Vinorelbine",
      "type": "active comparator",
      "dose": "30 mg/m2",
      "route": "IV",
      "frequency": "on days 1 and 8, every 21 days",
      "duration_weeks": 96
    },
    {
      "name": "Gemcitabine",
      "type": "active comparator",
      "dose": "1000 mg/m2",
      "route": "IV",
      "frequency": "on days 1 and 8, every 21 days",
      "duration_weeks": 96
    }
  ]
